description: Preflight: Brokkr's verify and review seats pointed at an UNMERGED branch, before a pull request exists. The table has no intake, no implement and no ship phase and it ends after review — so a preflight run can only produce a ruling, never a change and never a merge. The constitutional review invariants hold unchanged: review is unavoidable on the path to done, security-hold is a hard stop, security residuals never pass, and a reviewer that claims it edited the branch is itself the defect.

rules.reason: The branch does not pass the gates it will face; the report is the ruling. Fix what it names and run preflight again.
The local gates are green; the review seat reads verified evidence rather than a claim.
High or critical security findings on the branch. Risk acceptance is the operator's, never an agent's — and never a preflight's.
Residual severity above medium; the branch is not ready to be proposed.
Security residuals never qualify as a clean preflight, at any severity.
The read-only reviewer claims it changed the contributor's branch: charter violation, park-grade defect in the preflight itself.
Non-security residuals at or below medium: the branch may be proposed with the findings named in the pull request. Omitted severity inputs fall here flagged — the contributor reads the notes.
Nothing remains. Open the pull request; the human review starts from here rather than from the obvious.
The read-only reviewer claims it changed the contributor's branch: charter violation, park-grade defect in the preflight itself.
